about: Cloud binding table (owned core E): what `dryas cloud` puts into a repo for claude.ai/code cloud sessions. Every core component of the inventory kinds command, skill, agent, MCP server, plugin hook, chain stage and component is copied, opt-in or excluded with a reason. tools/inventory.py --check enforces it.

entries.chain_stage:post:bridge-deliver:core: copy: .dryas/jev/chain.json (delivers nothing in a cloud copy: no other accounts there)
entries.chain_stage:pretool:flowobserve:flowobse: exclude: FlowObserve is not in a cloud session; the stage ships disabled
entries.chain_stage:pretool:jev-gate:jev: copy: .dryas/jev/chain.json (local judge unless the environment opts into Jev)
entries.chain_stage:pretool:ruflo-pre-bash:ruflo: exclude: Ruflo needs Node and npm; the stage ships disabled
entries.chain_stage:prompt:bridge-deliver:core: copy: .dryas/jev/chain.json (delivers nothing in a cloud copy: no other accounts there)
entries.chain_stage:prompt:flowobserve:flowobser: exclude: FlowObserve is not in a cloud session; the stage ships disabled
entries.chain_stage:prompt:jev-route:jev: copy: .dryas/jev/chain.json (local judge unless the environment opts into Jev)
entries.chain_stage:prompt:usage-watch:core: exclude: needs FlowObserve on 127.0.0.1 and the cl multi-account launcher, neither exists in a cloud session; it would fail silent
entries.command:claude:dryas-cloud: copy: .claude/commands/dryas-cloud.md (check only, inside a cloud session)
entries.command:claude:retro: exclude: not in the cloud command set (spec E, section 1)
entries.component:design: opt-in: --with-design (each skill only with a confirmed licence and a NOTICE line)
entries.component:optional:jev: copy: the gate and route stages and the jev MCP server; local judge by default
entries.component:optional:memory: copy: Dryas memory in .dryas/state/; notes in the repo with --persist-memory
entries.component:optional:pstack-picks: copy: .dryas/pstack/ and the pstack-picks rule blocks
entries.component:optional:rea: exclude: REA needs Node and local reverse-engineering tools; not in cloud installs
entries.component:optional:ruflo: exclude: Ruflo needs Node and npm
entries.component:optional:superpowers: exclude: the Dryas process skills replace it
entries.component:ruflo: exclude: Ruflo needs Node and npm
entries.component:superpowers: exclude: the Dryas process skills replace it
entries.plugin_hook:claude:SessionStart:startup|: exclude: the CLAUDE.md rules block carries the rules in a repo copy
entries.skill:claude:benchmark-checklist: exclude: not in the cloud skill set (spec E, section 3); its checklist ships in .dryas/pstack/

not_copied.update-my-vault: its vault and sources are on the Mac
not_copied.fo-iterm: it drives iTerm on the Mac
not_copied.Superpowers: the Dryas process skills replace it
